contracts.source: Applied Materials press release: Applied Materials and Besi Expand Strategic Partnership to (10-01-2026)
contracts.signal: Applied Materials and Besi expanded their strategic partnership: Besi joins Applied's EPIC Center as an Innovation Partner, with Besi engineers working alongside Applied's teams, extending the joint development program launched in 2020 (the joint Hybrid Bonding Center of Excellence at Applied's Advanced Packaging Development Center in Singapore, which produced Kinex, which the companies call the industry's first integrated die-to-wafer hybrid bonding system). The expanded scope targets next-generation 3D IC scaling and logic and memory integration for AI compute and memory architectures; expected R&D programs: new die-to-wafer hybrid bonding platforms, scaling of thermo-compression bonding (TCB) and its process ecosystem, new die-on-wafer, die-on-die and die-on-panel integration platforms, and photonics-enabled interconnect applications supporting co-packaged optics. Applied CEO Gary Dickerson: the work lets both companies co-optimize the full packaging flow; Besi CEO Richard Blickman: the Singapore center has been foundational to Besi's hybrid bonding roadmap.
contracts.type: partnership (EPIC Center innovation partner, joint packaging R&D)
